question: Calculate \(\sqrt{9}+\sqrt[3]{(-8)}-|1-\sqrt{2}|\).
solution: \(\sqrt{9}=3\) and \(\sqrt[3]{(-8)}=-2\). Since \(1-\sqrt{2}<0\), \(|1-\sqrt{2}|=\sqrt{2}-1\). The original expression equals \(3-2-(\sqrt{2}-1)=2-\sqrt{2}\).
